facts.summary: Priced dilutive $2.50/share offering after reverse split; stock was $4.51 · Phase 3 completed · Multikine in head and neck cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: We are offering 2,000,000 shares of our common stock par value $0.01 per share, pursuant to this prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus. The shares will be sold for a purchase price of $2.50 per share.
evidence.safety: There were no Multikine-related deaths, no Multikine-related delays of surgery, no Multikine-related interference with post-surgical treatment, and only two discontinuations.
